name: Aden (1963–1967)
description: Three horizontal bands of blue, white and blue with a red wedge at the hoist, and a green five-pointed star centred on the white band.
history: Flag of the State of Aden — the former Crown Colony of Aden after it acceded to the British-sponsored Federation of South Arabia on 18 January 1963. It flew until the British withdrawal of 30 November 1967, when Aden and the protectorate states became the People's Republic of South Yemen, united with the north as Yemen in 1990.

features.role: green five-pointed star on the white band
